headline: Central Banks Purchase 321 Tonnes of Gold in Third Quarter
summary: Central banks bought 321 tonnes of gold in the third quarter of 2026, bringing total year-to-date purchases to 675 tonnes, a 6% increase year-on-year, according to the World Gold Council.
why: Official sector gold accumulation acts as a major structural support for global gold bullion prices and reflects central bank reserve diversification strategies.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Higher central bank physical demand reduces available supply and supports gold prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Substantial official sector buying increases structural demand for bullion, providing a price floor despite high retail jewellery price resistance.
